label: 🧬 PCA (dimensionality reduction)
description: Principal Component Analysis — reduces N numeric columns to K orthogonal components ordered by variance explained. Adds PC1..PCK columns to the data and renders a 2-D scatter of the first two components.

columns.label: Input columns
columns.help: Numeric columns to project. Empty = all numeric columns.

scale.label: Standardize (zero-mean, unit-variance)
scale.help: Strongly recommended unless your columns are already on the same scale.

color_by.label: Color points by (in plot)
color_by.help: Optional categorical or numeric column used to color points in the rendered scatter.
